ChoiceOption.description: One card the traveller can pick.

area.description: The place's neighbourhood or area, or, for a destination, the rough travel time there by the chosen mode ("Circa 2 h di volo"); one line, at most 60 characters, no URL. Omit when unknown.

duration_min.description: Typical duration in minutes, 1 to 1440. Omit when it does not apply.

id.description: Short identifier unique among the options: 1 to 32 letters, digits, '_' or '-', e.g. 'a1'. The answer refers to options by this id.

place.description: The place's name and its city ("Torre de Belém, Lisboa"), a destination's city and country, or a food style's best-known dish ("Bacalhau à Brás"); one line, at most 120 characters, no URL; used only to look up a photo. Omit it otherwise.

price.description: Indicative price for the whole party. Omit when unknown.

reason.description: Why this option fits this traveller, Italian, one line, at most 140 characters, no URL.

title.description: Name of the option, Italian, one line, at most 80 characters, no URL.

ChoiceOption.title: ChoiceOption

ChoicePrice.description: What an option costs, for the whole party.

amount_cents.description: Total amount times 100, as an integer, for the whole party: 12.50 EUR is 1250.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code in upper case, e.g. EUR, USD, GBP.

ChoicePrice.title: ChoicePrice

description: The input of `ask_traveller`: one question with 2 to 6 options.

kind.description: What the question is about: 'destination', 'journey' (the travel mode), 'activities', 'food' or 'other'. Each kind can be asked once per plan; 'destination', 'journey' and 'other' share one slot.

multiple.description: true for 'activities' and 'food' (the traveller may pick several), false otherwise (exactly one).

options.description: 2 to 6 options with unique ids; 'activities' needs at least 3. Offer only options you would put in the plan.

question.description: The question, Italian, one line, at most 120 characters, no URL.
